dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a high-degree concave curvature, fitting a spline that starts near-vertical below the apex and terminates at a near-horizontal slope at the posterior base insertion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Apex is characterized as rounded with a small pixel radius of curvature.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin follows a roughly linear path at an approximate 35-degree angle relative to the horizontal axis of the visible dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of maximum horizontal base width to maximum vertical height is approximately 2.8:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible white punctate speckling across the lateral surface of the fin. One distinct white depigmented patch is located on the upper leading edge. A horizontal band of lighter grey pigmentation/scarring transverses the lower section of the fin.
